descEn: for loops and if/else — real Python power!

teacherGuide.conceptGu: for loop = same action repeat. if/else = decision. range(5) = 0,1,2,3,4. Indentation = Python rule — spaces matter! Loop + condition = AI algorithm foundation.
teacherGuide.conceptEn: for loop iterates, if/else decides. Indentation is Python syntax. These two concepts power almost all programs.
teacherGuide.conceptDa: Et for-loop gentager en handling. if/else træffer beslutninger. range(5) giver tallene 0,1,2,3,4. Indrykning (indentation) med mellemrum er super vigtigt i Python! Loops + betingelser er grundlaget for AI.
teacherGuide.storyGu: 'for i in range(5): print(i) = 0,1,2,3,4 print! Loop 5 times! Robot clean 5 rooms = for loop! if score > 10: print("Winner!") = game logic!'
teacherGuide.storyEn: for i in range(5): print(i) prints 0, 1, 2, 3, 4. If a robot cleans 5 rooms, it runs a for-loop! if score > 10: print("Winner!") is how games display high scores!
teacherGuide.storyDa: for i in range(5): print(i) udskriver 0, 1, 2, 3, 4. Hvis en robot skal støvsuge 5 værelser, bruger den et for-loop! if score > 10: print("Vinder!") styrer highscores i spil!
teacherGuide.scriptGu: 'Try in replit: for i in range(3): print("Hello Yuval!") — watch Hello print 3 times! Magic!'
teacherGuide.scriptEn: Write in Replit: for i in range(3): print("Hello!"). Watch it print 3 times! Explain that the spaces before print() are mandatory in Python.
teacherGuide.scriptDa: Prøv i Replit: for i in range(3): print("Hej!"). Det udskrives 3 gange! Vis barnet, at indrykningen med TAB-tasten er obligatorisk i Python.
teacherGuide.tipsGu: 💡 replit.com — type for loop together! See output 3 times = wow moment! Indentation with TAB key — show it matters!
teacherGuide.tipsEn: 💡 Type a loop together. Show what happens if you forget to indent — Python raises an IndentationError. A perfect debugging lesson!
teacherGuide.tipsDa: 💡 Skriv et loop sammen. Vis, hvad der sker, hvis man glemmer indrykningen — Python brokker sig med en IndentationError. Det lærer dem fejlfinding!

questions.textGu: for i in range(6): — loop _____ times run?
questions.textEn: How many times does: for i in range(6) run?
questions.textDa: Hvor mange gange kører: for i in range(6)?
questions.hintDa: range(6) tæller fra 0 til 5 — det er 6 gange!

questions.hintGu: range(8) = 0 થી start, 8 BEFORE stop! 0 થી 7!
questions.hintEn: range(8) starts at 0, stops before 8 (so 0 to 7)!
questions.hintDa: range(8) starter altid ved 0 og stopper lige før 8 (så 0 til 7)!

questions.textEn: if score > 15: print("Win!"). If score=12, what prints?
questions.textDa: if score > 15: print("Vinder!"). Hvis score=12, hvad udskrives?
questions.hintGu: 12 > 15? No! So if block skip — nothing prints!
questions.hintEn: 12 is NOT greater than 15, so condition is False — nothing prints!
questions.hintDa: 12 er ikke større end 15, så betingelsen er falsk — der udskrives intet!

questions.textGu: if age >= 18: print("Adult") else: print("Child"). age=17, output?
questions.textEn: if age >= 18: print("Adult") else: print("Child"). age=17?
questions.textDa: if age >= 18: print("Voksen") else: print("Barn"). Hvis age=17?
questions.hintEn: 17 is NOT >= 18, so else runs: Child!
questions.hintDa: 17 er mindre end 18, så 'else' kører: Barn!

questions.textGu: for i in range(5): print("Hi!") — total output lines?
questions.textEn: for i in range(5): print("Hi!"). How many lines print?
questions.textDa: for i in range(5): print("Hej!"). Hvor mange linjer udskrives?
questions.hintGu: range(5) = 5 times! Hi! Hi! Hi! Hi! Hi!
questions.hintEn: Loop runs 5 times: Hi! five times!

questions.textGu: AI training = data ઉપર loop. 1000 images train = ?
questions.textEn: AI training loops over data. Training on 1000 images uses a ___?
questions.textDa: AI-træning looper over data. Træning på 1000 billeder bruger et ___?
questions.hintGu: for image in dataset: train! Loop over all images = AI training!
questions.hintEn: for loop over all training data — that's how AI learns!
questions.hintDa: for-loopet kører igennem alle billederne — det er sådan AI lærer!
